regime_context: The detector shows Semiconductors as the top momentum theme, AI Compute close behind, and Industrial Metals as the most durably trending eligible theme. Absolute-trend gate historically failed to reduce drawdown on China A-shares, and cross-sectional rank-IC is ~0, so these ranks are a focus lens only. Any directional lean must be low conviction and falsifiable.
emerging_watch: AI Compute & Optics (cn_ai_compute) – challenger to Semiconductors, eligible, and score margin only 0.171. Watch for a confirmed leadership handoff if its score overtakes Semiconductors while remaining eligible and breadth (currently 0.118) improves. Kill if margin widens >0.5 or AI Compute becomes ineligible.

theses.subject: Industrial Metals
theses.thesis: Within the eligible trend-following universe, Industrial Metals shows the highest trend durability (0.69) and broadest participation (breadth 0.462) without crowding, suggesting a relatively robust continuation structure. While not the leader, it offers a durable trend in a market where the absolute-trend gate historically did not improve drawdowns—hence, a conservative ‘trend health’ overweight.
theses.dissent: The mean-reverting nature of A-shares sectors historically whipsawed trend-following; the gate did not reduce drawdown here. A sudden reversal in commodity demand or Chinese industrial policy could break the trend despite the high durability reading.

falsifier.text: Industrial Metals becomes ineligible (absolute-trend gate flips) OR its durability_bar drops below 0.5 within 20 days.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
